messages.message: Currently, I am working as a freelance Shopify developer and actively seeking new opportunities in software development. My experience spans:
Cloud Infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, and Networking.
Backend Development: C++ (Wt framework), REST APIs, RPC (ZeroC Ice), database design and ORM (Wt Dbo).
Frontend Development: Server-side rendering (SSR) and client-side rendering (CSR), CSS, Tailwind CSS, and component-based libraries.
CI/CD: Jenkins pipelines for automated builds and deployments.
Data Warehousing: ETL processes and mapping design with Informatica PowerCenter.
Client Communication: Skilled in understanding requirements, clarifying objectives, and maintaining clear, professional communication.
